LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY: POEM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem, part of Strand 6 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we display appropriate expressions when reading a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. preview a text before reading,

2. skim a text to obtain the main idea,

3. Scan a text to obtain specific details,

4. ignore unknown words

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. preview a text before reading,
2. skim a text to obtain the main idea,
3. Scan a text to obtain specific details,
4. ignore unknown words

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poem together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner recognises opinions of others while engaging in a reader’s theatre.

• Self- efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner fluently reads given poems.

Values:
Responsibility: It is enhanced as the learner engages in assigned roles and duties such as downloading sample texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: It is enriched as the learner perfects their reading skills.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates reading fluency to reading in other languages such as Kiswahili.
